summary: F01, F03, and F05 are implemented in src/ui/mapping.rs: the D-pad middle row now declares its size so the centered stage centers it, the card footer pairs the left-aligned "4 directions mapped" caption with the right-aligned unique/duplicate status, and the joystick dot interpolates its displacement with the reference's 75 ms ease-out segment instead of teleporting.

DPAD-CLUSTER-ALIGNMENT.evidence: mapping_pad now lays the LEFT/tile/RIGHT row out through ui.allocate_ui_with_layout(DPAD_ROW_SIZE, ...) so the centered stage centers a child whose size it can measure before layout; the widget test the_dpad_cluster_rows_share_one_center_axis asserts UP, DOWN, and the tile share the vertical axis, LEFT, RIGHT, and the tile share the horizontal axis, and the row is symmetric about the tile (the same harness measured the tile center at x=187 against UP at x=520 before the change).

MAPPING-FOOTER-LABEL.evidence: footer paints the left-aligned, non-bold "4 directions mapped" caption in theme::ICON_MUTED (#94a3b8, the reference's slate-400) beside the right-aligned assignment_status; the widget test the_footer_pairs_the_direction_count_with_the_status asserts the caption and the status exist, share one row (center y within 1 px), and the caption sits left of the status.

DPAD-DOT-INTERPOLATION.evidence: dpad_center_tile keeps a DotMotion segment (frame temp memory) and paints its interpolated offset; DOT_TRAVEL_SECS is 0.075 with the CSS cubic-bezier(0, 0, 0.58, 1) ease-out curve, a mid-flight retarget continues from the displayed offset, and the tile requests repaints only while in flight. The widget test the_dpad_dot_glides_to_its_target shows the toggle frame keeping the previous offset, the next 16 ms frame strictly inside the travel, and the settle on the 18 px cardinal target with no remaining repaint request; pure tests cover the curve shape, the duration, and retargeting.

risks: The F03 caption is not yet an entry in src/ui/language/en.rs (not an owned file), so it renders through the documented English-source fallback in every language until the language inventory owner adds it.

The stage's hint row ("Click keycap to rebind") is still left-aligned by the same bare ui.horizontal mechanism this task fixed for the middle row; measured in the test harness at center x=122 against the stage center x=520. It is outside F01's cluster and unchanged by this diff; the stage owner may want a bounded item for it.
Native on-screen validation was not performed: the acceptance evidence is widget-level layout, painted-shape, and state assertions in egui_kittest, not a desktop screenshot.
